subject: Task B4: Add inline definition for 'extraneous solutions' — all practice exams
body: GR, Marcus flagged during live test review that Question 10 on every practice exam uses the phrase "extraneous solutions" with no explanation. Kai may not know what this word means and will be confused. This is a real vocabulary risk during his actual SAAS test. CONFIRMED: "extraneous solutions" IS the correct Algebra II term (Common Core HSA-REI.A.2). It is in standards.json as a named skill. Do not remove it. But Kai needs to understand what it means before he sees it in a question. THE FIX In retake-practice-1.json through retake-practice-7.json, update Question 10's question_html to include a plain-English inline definition the FIRST time "extraneous" appears. Current question_html (example from practice-2): "Solve and check for extraneous solutions: \\( \\sqrt{x + 3} = x - 3 \\)" Updated question_html: "Solve and check for extraneous solutions (answers that come from the algebra but don't actually work when you plug them back in): \\( \\sqrt{x + 3} = x - 3 \\)" Apply this same pattern to all 7 practice files. The definition wording must be: "answers that come from the algebra but don't actually work when you plug them back in" Do not paraphrase — Marcus approved this exact language. Also update the hint field for Q10 in each file. Current hint is about vertex form (wrong question). Q10 hint should say: "Always check your answers by plugging them back into the original equation. If both sides don't match, the solution is extraneous — it came from the algebra but isn't actually valid." SCOPE Only data/retake-practice-1.json through retake-practice-7.json, Q10 in each. Do not touch exam.html or any other files. DEFINITION OF DONE 1. All 7 practice files updated 2. The word "extraneous" is defined inline in the question text 3. Q10 hint is accurate and helpful 4. Commit with message: fix(GR): define extraneous solutions inline for Kai (Q10 all practices) Kai is testing on the live site right now. Prioritize this. — FA
